title: Trade Coffee Alternatives: 5 Subscriptions Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Trade Coffee alternative? Compare five coffee subscriptions by price, freshness, and roaster variety, from roasted-to-order bags to K-cups.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Fresher and costs less


### Bell Lap Coffee vs Trade Coffee


[Monthly Coffee Subscription - (1) 12 oz. bag per month](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bell-lap-coffee) by Bell Lap Coffee


From $11.95 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bell-lap-coffee)


**Best for:** The drinker who liked Trade’s freshness and wants to pick the roast and pay less per bag.


Bell Lap roasts to order: place an order before 6 p.m. Central on a Monday, and it roasts on Tuesday and ships on Wednesday. Each month brings one 12 oz bag in the roast you choose, French, Vienna, medium, light, Swiss Water decaf, or the roaster’s pick, whole bean or ground coarse, medium, or fine.


#### What feels familiar


The coffee reaches you days after it’s roasted, the same promise Trade makes.


#### What changes


You pick a roast profile instead of taking a quiz, and it comes from one roaster, so the variety is in your roast choice. It costs about half of Trade’s typical bag, and it ships to Canada, the UK, Australia, and Switzerland, which Trade doesn’t.


A new coffee every month


### Goodbirds Coffee vs Trade Coffee


[Goodbirds Coffee that Gives Back (Whole Bean)](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/goodbirds-coffee-of-the-month) by Goodbirds Coffee


From $18.99 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/goodbirds-coffee-of-the-month)


**Best for:** Someone who subscribes for the surprise of a new bag and likes knowing where the money goes.


Goodbirds sends a 12 oz bag of limited-edition coffee each month, chosen for flavor, and both the coffee and the cause it supports change every delivery. The seller gives 100% of its net profits to good causes.


#### What feels familiar


A different coffee keeps arriving, so the bag in your cupboard doesn’t turn into a routine, and you can skip or cancel anytime.


#### What changes


Goodbirds picks each month’s coffee rather than matching one to your taste, and it ships monthly instead of every two weeks. US shipping adds a flat $5 a delivery.


For a K-cup brewer


### Single Cup Club vs Trade Coffee


Best of 2024


[Single Cup Club Membership](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/single-cup-club) by Single Cup Club


From $19.99 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/single-cup-club)


**Best for:** A single-serve household that wants a monthly change of coffee without grinding or measuring.


Each month brings 15 hand-picked K-cups in three blends. You choose flavored, non-flavored, or a mix, and the club chooses the coffees.


#### What feels familiar


Three blends in every box keep the sampling spirit of Trade, just in a pod.


#### What changes


You trade fresh whole beans for convenience, and there are no substitutions or special requests. Boxes ship in the first week of the month, so an order placed on the 1st or later waits for the next month’s batch. It ships within the US only.


The most roasters


### Bean Box vs Trade Coffee


**Best for:** The Trade subscriber whose favorite part is meeting a new roaster, and who wants to set the pace.


[Bean Box](https://beanbox.com/) works with 64 independent roasters across the US. You pick from eight profiles, from Light & Bright to Dark & Toasty, single origin, espresso, decaf, or cold brew, and Bean Box tunes later picks to your ratings. Bean Box isn’t sold on Cratejoy, so the link goes to the brand’s own site.


#### What feels familiar


This is the closest outside match to Trade: many small roasters, profiles instead of a single house blend, and picks that shift with your feedback.


#### What changes


Deliveries run every two to six weeks, with one or two 12 oz bags, a 2 lb bag, or a 5 lb bag, and shipping is included in the subscription price. You can pause, skip, or cancel, but a cancellation has to be in by 1 p.m. Pacific on the Wednesday before a shipment.


Learn your own taste


### Driftaway Coffee vs Trade Coffee


**Best for:** The curious drinker who would sooner taste side by side than trust a quiz.


[Driftaway](https://store.driftaway.coffee/) starts with a Coffee Explorer box, five 2-ounce coffees from around the world for $33. You taste them, pick the profiles you liked, and the subscription follows those profiles. Plans run from $15 to $22 a shipment in 12-ounce, 1-pound, or 2-pound sizes. Driftaway isn’t sold on Cratejoy, so the link goes to the brand’s own site.


#### What feels familiar


Your taste steers what arrives, and the coffee rotates within the style you like.


#### What changes


You decide by drinking five samples instead of answering questions, and plans are organized by roast style: light, medium and dark, espresso, or all roasts.
